tooltips.ambientLighting: Disable to hide the Ambient Lighting
tooltips.nightAsDay: Light the night side of the Earth as if it were day
tooltips.graticule: Draw latitude and longitude grid lines on the Earth
tooltips.politicalMap: Draw country borders on the Earth
tooltips.dimOrbitInEclipse: Dim the part of the selected orbit line where the satellite is in Earth's shadow
tooltips.orbitEclipseAlpha: Opacity of the orbit line in Earth's shadow: 0.05 nearly hides it, 1 means no dimming
tooltips.orbitFadeFactor: How far along the orbit line stays bright before it fades: lower values fade sooner

help.overview: The Graphics menu controls how the scene looks. Pick an Overall Quality level to set every quality-aware setting at once, then adjust individual settings in the cards below. Changes apply immediately and persist between sessions.
help.imgAlt: The Graphics menu with the overall quality selector and setting cards
help.imgCaption: The overall quality selector at the top, setting cards below, and Reset to Defaults at the bottom.
help.howToUse:
1. Open Graphics Menu from the drawer in the Settings group.
  2. Click Low, Medium, High, or Ultra to set every quality-aware setting in one step.
  3. Change any setting below to fine-tune the look; the selector then shows Custom.
  4. Type in the filter box to find a setting by name.
  5. Click Reset to Defaults to restore every graphics setting.
help.tip1: The selector shows Custom whenever your settings do not match a level exactly. Pick a level again to return to it.
help.tip2: If the frame rate drops, KeepTrack may turn off costly effects on its own. The menu then notes that settings were reduced automatically.
